set.body: Outcome: cohesive map-reference scoring subsystem with compatible legacy wrappers. Scope: shared lookup and matching/sampling, overlap windows, leave-out references, controls, scaling, contrasts and mismatch draws; synthetic vignette. Non-goals: bandwidth selection, study-specific models, publication. Invariants: preserve legacy defaults/output/RNG and S3 dispatch; explicit map domain and keys; deterministic scoring of retained assignments; subject-balanced sparse references. Evidence: legacy characterization; independent reference fixtures; simulations; devtools::test(), document(), check(), coverage. Next: define contracts and capture baseline.
set.title: Integrate fixation reference scoring and replayable sampling (#53)
